overview_description.description: Delegasi is an AI-powered virtual financial assistant that enables food and beverage business owners to obtain financial statements and actionable insights by simply uploading receipts. They provide the income statement, cash flow, balance sheet, business analysis, control the use of raw materials, estimated cash for profit sharing, and expansion services.
